settings.heading: Three steps, then it looks after itself

settings.question: How do the subscription discounts work?
settings.answer: Each frequency carries its own discount, applied to every delivery for as long as the subscription runs. Monthly saves 5%, every two months saves 8% and quarterly saves 12%.

settings.question: When is my first box sent?
settings.answer: Straight away. Your first delivery ships as soon as the order is placed, and the next one follows on the frequency you chose.

settings.question: Can I change my frequency later?
settings.answer: Yes. Subscriptions are managed from your customer account, where you can change frequency, skip a delivery, pause or cancel.

settings.question: Can I buy a box without subscribing?
settings.answer: Of course. Every subscription box can also be bought once, at the standard one-time price, using the purchase options on the product page.

settings.question: What is actually in each box?
settings.answer: The contents change every cycle, which is rather the point. Each product page lists what the current edition includes and roughly how many pieces to expect.

settings.question: Can I send a subscription as a gift?
settings.answer: For gifting we recommend The Weekend Gift Box, which is a one-time purchase and arrives gift-wrapped with a note card.

settings.heading: First look at every edition
settings.body: A short note each month: what is in the next box, who made it, and the occasional thing we think you will like.
settings.success_text: You are on the list. Look out for the next edition.
